title: LAN Party
description: Find triangles and the largest fully-connected group in a computer network.
writeup:
## Approach

Build an adjacency graph from the connection list.

## Part 1

Find all triangles (3-cliques) where at least one computer starts with 't'. For each 't'-computer, check all pairs of its neighbours to see if they're also connected to each other.

## Part 2

Find the largest clique in the graph. For each computer, greedily build a clique by adding nodes that connect to all current members. While this greedy approach doesn't guarantee finding the maximum clique in general, the structure of AoC inputs (sparse, well-structured graphs) makes it work reliably. The answer is the sorted, comma-joined list of computers in the largest clique.
